game: IND @ WAS, Week 4 2026 / kickoff, spread, total, rest, travel, roof and surface not saved / weather not saved

script.base: No spread or total is saved, so this is an injury-and-form script, not a market script. Jayden Daniels (elbow) is out, so Marcus Mariota starts and Washington loses Daniels' 12 carries for 100 yards (8.3 YPC); Rachaad White (shoulder) and G Sam Cosmi (concussion) are also out. Base read: a competitive game, Indianapolis still built around Jonathan Taylor (66 carries, 258 yards) and Josh Downs (24 targets), Washington a less explosive dropback team that splits carries between Jacory Croskey-Merritt (47/142, 3.02 YPC) and a larger Kaytron Allen share rather than a run-only or pass-only script.
script.flip1: Washington stays close or leads at home. Mariota does not have to abandon the run, so Allen and Croskey-Merritt both keep carries against an Indianapolis run defense allowing 5.08 YPC, while Indianapolis throws to catch up and Downs' target volume holds or rises.
script.flip2: Indianapolis leads early and clocks the game with Taylor. Washington abandons the run, Allen and Croskey-Merritt carry lines die, and Mariota's attempts funnel to Stefon Diggs, Antonio Williams and Dyami Brown, especially if Terry McLaurin (hamstring, questionable) is limited.

pre_mortem: Allen over loses if Croskey-Merritt absorbs White's 22 carries and 9 targets and Allen stays a 3-carry extra, or if Cosmi's absence plus an early Indianapolis lead cuts the run game off at 8-12 yards. The -114.5 was never better than a 50.2% fair, so there is no price cushion if the market already knew the role. Downs over loses if this is the 37-yard version: Washington brackets the only high-air target, the 47% blitz finally hits, or Indianapolis is ahead and Taylor (22 carries a game, 3.91 YPC) finishes the clock. A 72 rung above a 62-yard mean is exactly how a real matchup still misses. If those counters feel stronger on either leg Monday morning, the lean should have been a pass.
slip_story: One story only: Washington is not blown out. In the base or in flip 1 (Washington close or ahead), Allen gets a few carries against the 5.08 YPC run defense and Indianapolis still has to throw to Downs. Do not parlay this with a total under, a Taylor rush over, or a Washington pass-catcher over — those need a different flow. Two legs, no touchdowns, one market per player. Correlation is moderate, not a shootout stack; if a late inactive flips McLaurin or Keenan Allen, rerun before kickoff.
